name: reset_workspace
description: Reset the entire shared virtual filesystem to the app's checked-in initial workspace, using the same template as initialization. Deletes all custom files, skills, installed demos and custom bin tools, including files outside ~, and restores default rules and tools. Destructive: use only when the user requests a full workspace reset. Preserves conversations, tabs and provider settings. Resets this agent's cwd to ~ and reloads tools for the next run; running calls keep their original definitions.
